reason: Examined prerequisite statements/proofs for thm-nontrivial-center-of-a-finite-p-group, def-normalizer-of-a-subgroup, def-quotient-group; full-text source evidence: Paul Flavell, An Introduction to Transfer and Fusion in Finite Groups, §§2–5 §§2–5, PDF pp. 1–15; Hans Kurzweil and Bernd Stellmacher, The Theory of Finite Groups, §§7.1–7.2 §§7.1–7.2, printed pp. 163–171; argument: Induct on |P|. If Z(P)⊄S, a central element outside S normalizes it. Otherwise Z(P)≤S; apply induction in the smaller p-group P/Z(P) to S/Z(P), then lift a normalizing coset outside S. This avoids relying on an abbreviated published normalizer proof.
